svg.title: Enterprise Trading Platform: runtime architecture
svg.desc: The Angular app talks to the auth-service, the order-service and the executor-service. The order and executor services exchange orders and events through Kafka and share the trading database; the auth-service has its own database. Third-party APIs are called from the services, never from the browser.
svg.text: Runtime view: who talks to whom, and over what
